Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> In its first-quarter 2024 results announced on April 23, 2024, for the period ending March 31, 2024, Freeport-McMoRan reported the sale of 20 million pounds of molybdenum. [2] This represented a 5% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. [2] The company's revenues for the quarter rose approximately 17% year-over-year to $6.321 billion, surpassing analyst estimates. [2] <2> In the first quarter of 2024, United States molybdenum prices demonstrated remarkable stability, bolstered by robust demand from the steel industry and consistent operations from major producers, including Freeport-McMoRan Inc. and Southern Copper Corp. A notable price increase occurred in February 2024, which was propelled by a significant surge in demand that kept smelters operating at full capacity as steel mills continued to place substantial orders. <3> The spot price for molybdenum was $51,257.48 per metric ton as of November 30, 2023. [1] This value was unchanged from the price recorded at the end of the previous month, October 31, 2023. [1] The price is based on the London Metal Exchange (LME) spot price for roasted molybdenum concentrate with 57% to 63% purity. [1] <4> In its third-quarter 2023 results announced on October 31, 2023, Centerra Gold lowered the full-year gold production guidance for its Mount Milligan Mine, a significant copper and gold producer in British Columbia. The guidance was revised down to a range of 150,000 to 160,000 ounces from the previous 160,000 to 170,000 ounces. This change was attributed to mine sequencing and lower-than-planned gold recoveries, which resulted from blending different types of ore from various phases of the open-pit mine. In the third quarter of 2023, the Mount Milligan Mine produced 39,554 ounces of gold and 15.0 million pounds of copper. Centerra Gold's Molybdenum Business Unit is separate from the Mount Milligan operation. <5> According to the International Molybdenum Association (IMOA), global production of molybdenum increased by 1% to 148.5 million pounds in the second quarter of 2023. [1] In North America, production saw a more substantial increase of 5%, reaching 28.4 million pounds during the same period. [1] The data for the quarter, which concluded on June 30, 2023, was publicly released on October 16, 2023. <6> According to an S&P Global report, the molybdenum market began to stabilize starting in September 2023, following a period of historic volatility. This stabilization came after prices reached record highs in February 2023, when a combination of acute factors and a sustained supply deficit drove them to nearly $40 per pound of Mo contained. <7> A retrospective analysis of the first half of 2023 confirmed significant volatility in the molybdenum market. [1, 2] Prices for the metal peaked in February before experiencing a sharp decline in March and April. [1, 2] This price fluctuation was attributed to a convergence of factors, including an initial recovery in demand that surpassed supply levels. [1] This imbalance was further exacerbated by geopolitical instability in key production areas in South America, alongside logistical and production challenges in Europe. [1] <8> A report from S&P Global indicates that after a period of significant volatility and record-high prices in early 2023, molybdenum prices saw a rapid decline in March and April. This downturn was attributed to high interest rates and a poor demand outlook, which discouraged speculative trading. However, a price uptick occurred in late April as the import window for China opened, signaling a recovery in demand for products containing molybdenum. <9> On September 18, 2023, Centerra Gold Inc. announced the completion of a pre-feasibility study (PFS) for the restart of its Thompson Creek molybdenum mine in Idaho, which has been on care and maintenance since 2014. [3, 6] The study supported a plan to restart operations, and as a result, the company initiated a full feasibility study. [3, 6] This subsequent feasibility study was initially expected to be completed by mid-2024, with the goal of bringing the mine back into production with first output anticipated in the second half of 2027. [3, 6] Following the PFS, the company planned to authorize between $100 million and $200 million for pre-stripping and long-lead time equipment purchases. [6] <10> The American Iron and Steel Institute (AISI) reported that in July 2023, U.S. steel mills shipped 7,550,446 net tons. [1] This represented a 1.4% decrease from the 7,655,692 net tons shipped in June 2023 and a 1.6% decrease from the 7,676,083 net tons shipped in July 2022. [1] Year-to-date shipments for the first seven months of 2023 totaled 51,866,292 net tons, which is a 3.3% decrease compared to the same period in 2022. [1] The decline in steel shipments, a key indicator for molybdenum demand, suggests a potential softening in the market.

Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> In its first-quarter 2024 results announced on April 23, 2024, for the period ending March 31, 2024, Freeport-McMoRan reported the sale of 20 million pounds of molybdenum. [2] This represented a 5% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. [2] The company's revenues for the quarter rose approximately 17% year-over-year to $6.321 billion, surpassing analyst estimates. [2] <2> In the first quarter of 2024, United States molybdenum prices demonstrated remarkable stability, bolstered by robust demand from the steel industry and consistent operations from major producers, including Freeport-McMoRan Inc. and Southern Copper Corp. A notable price increase occurred in February 2024, which was propelled by a significant surge in demand that kept smelters operating at full capacity as steel mills continued to place substantial orders. <3> The spot price for molybdenum was $51,257.48 per metric ton as of November 30, 2023. [1] This value was unchanged from the price recorded at the end of the previous month, October 31, 2023. [1] The price is based on the London Metal Exchange (LME) spot price for roasted molybdenum concentrate with 57% to 63% purity. [1] <4> In its third-quarter 2023 results announced on October 31, 2023, Centerra Gold lowered the full-year gold production guidance for its Mount Milligan Mine, a significant copper and gold producer in British Columbia. The guidance was revised down to a range of 150,000 to 160,000 ounces from the previous 160,000 to 170,000 ounces. This change was attributed to mine sequencing and lower-than-planned gold recoveries, which resulted from blending different types of ore from various phases of the open-pit mine. In the third quarter of 2023, the Mount Milligan Mine produced 39,554 ounces of gold and 15.0 million pounds of copper. Centerra Gold's Molybdenum Business Unit is separate from the Mount Milligan operation. <5> According to the International Molybdenum Association (IMOA), global production of molybdenum increased by 1% to 148.5 million pounds in the second quarter of 2023. [1] In North America, production saw a more substantial increase of 5%, reaching 28.4 million pounds during the same period. [1] The data for the quarter, which concluded on June 30, 2023, was publicly released on October 16, 2023. <6> According to an S&P Global report, the molybdenum market began to stabilize starting in September 2023, following a period of historic volatility. This stabilization came after prices reached record highs in February 2023, when a combination of acute factors and a sustained supply deficit drove them to nearly $40 per pound of Mo contained. <7> A retrospective analysis of the first half of 2023 confirmed significant volatility in the molybdenum market. [1, 2] Prices for the metal peaked in February before experiencing a sharp decline in March and April. [1, 2] This price fluctuation was attributed to a convergence of factors, including an initial recovery in demand that surpassed supply levels. [1] This imbalance was further exacerbated by geopolitical instability in key production areas in South America, alongside logistical and production challenges in Europe. [1] <8> A report from S&P Global indicates that after a period of significant volatility and record-high prices in early 2023, molybdenum prices saw a rapid decline in March and April. This downturn was attributed to high interest rates and a poor demand outlook, which discouraged speculative trading. However, a price uptick occurred in late April as the import window for China opened, signaling a recovery in demand for products containing molybdenum. <9> On September 18, 2023, Centerra Gold Inc. announced the completion of a pre-feasibility study (PFS) for the restart of its Thompson Creek molybdenum mine in Idaho, which has been on care and maintenance since 2014. [3, 6] The study supported a plan to restart operations, and as a result, the company initiated a full feasibility study. [3, 6] This subsequent feasibility study was initially expected to be completed by mid-2024, with the goal of bringing the mine back into production with first output anticipated in the second half of 2027. [3, 6] Following the PFS, the company planned to authorize between $100 million and $200 million for pre-stripping and long-lead time equipment purchases. [6] <10> The American Iron and Steel Institute (AISI) reported that in July 2023, U.S. steel mills shipped 7,550,446 net tons. [1] This represented a 1.4% decrease from the 7,655,692 net tons shipped in June 2023 and a 1.6% decrease from the 7,676,083 net tons shipped in July 2022. [1] Year-to-date shipments for the first seven months of 2023 totaled 51,866,292 net tons, which is a 3.3% decrease compared to the same period in 2022. [1] The decline in steel shipments, a key indicator for molybdenum demand, suggests a potential softening in the market.

Prediction target period: from 2025-12-15 to 2025-12-30. Recent related events (events are separated by numbered tags): <1> On October 7, 2025, an S&P Global report indicated that tariffs had a more pronounced effect on the ferromolybdenum spot market compared to the moly oxide market in the United States. This is primarily because the ferromolybdenum market has a greater dependency on imports. The report, authored by Teo Ngoma, also noted that despite the tariff impacts, the U.S. has the capacity to rely on its domestic molybdenum production. <2> A report published on October 7, 2025, revealed that spot prices for molybdenum oxide powder reached their highest level of the year, a surge that commenced in July attributed to a tightening supply of molybdenite concentrate. The Platts assessment for spot prices peaked at $26.025 per pound on September 3, 2025, a significant increase from $21.925 per pound on July 1. <3> A Zion Market Research report published on September 1, 2025, projects the global molybdenum market will experience steady growth over the next decade. The market size is anticipated to increase from approximately $4.60 billion in 2024 to $6.29 billion by 2034. This growth represents a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of about 4% for the forecast period of 2025 to 2034. Key drivers for this expansion include increased demand from the steel and chemical industries, as well as its use in oil and gas, automotive, construction, and aerospace and defense sectors. Molybdenum is noted for its use as an alloying agent that enhances the strength, corrosion resistance, and high-temperature tolerance of materials like steel. Other market analyses present different figures; for instance, a Future Market Insights report suggests the market could reach $548 billion by 2035 with a 4.7% CAGR, while a Market Research Future report projects a market value of $29.1 billion by 2035 with a 4.02% CAGR. <4> In the second quarter of 2025, the price of molybdenum in the United States reached 50,265 USD/Ton in June.; This was influenced by consistent demand from the stainless steel and aerospace industries,; steady domestic mining output, <5> monthly Molybdenum Spot Price at $46,349.57 for June 2025 <6> On July 8, 2025, the United States announced a 50% tariff on copper imports. [1] While the tariff did not directly apply to molybdenum, the action heightened market focus on strategic mineral resources, including molybdenum. [7] The tariff announcement caused significant volatility, with U.S. copper prices surging to a new record of $5.69 per pound on the same day. [6] The tariffs cover semi-finished copper goods and are intended to reduce U.S. reliance on foreign copper for national security and infrastructure purposes. [1] <7> influenced by fluctuating demand <8> A market analysis published on April 25, 2025; projected that the molybdenum industry in the USA would grow at a CAGR of 5.3% between 2025 and 2035; This growth is anticipated to be driven by its strategic use in steel production <9> The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) released its Mineral Industry Survey for molybdenum in January 2025 <10> In its first-quarter 2024 results announced on April 23, 2024, for the period ending March 31, 2024, Freeport-McMoRan reported the sale of 20 million pounds of molybdenum. [2] This represented a 5% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. [2] The company's revenues for the quarter rose approximately 17% year-over-year to $6.321 billion, surpassing analyst estimates. [2]
